compose_gtn_graphs: compose two GTN graphs together using gtn.compose to build a transducer
score_graph_forward: compute the forward score of a GTN graph using gtn.forward_score
decode_viterbi_path: find the best path through a GTN graph using gtn.viterbi_path
concatenate_gtn_graphs: concatenate multiple GTN graphs in sequence using gtn.concat
remove_epsilon_arcs: remove epsilon transitions from a GTN graph using gtn.remove
